draft.subject: AI you control
draft.body:
Hi Rhona,

Read your post about keeping client documents out of public AI tools until you find something you control. Here's a two-minute demo of what that can look like: https://demo.example.com/nextron/private-ai

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Worth a look?

claims.text: your post about keeping client documents out of public AI tools until you find something you control
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Rhona Gill, Managing Partner at Brackenfield Solicitors: we've told our team not to paste client documents into public AI tools until we find something we control.
Our 11 solicitors handle conveyancing, wills and probate.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
The Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
